selection.rule: Dependency-complete first 24 questions from the question-sheet selection order.

questions.question: Where did the man end up after traveling over rough land?
questions.answer: He ended up in a lonely, empty wilderness.

questions.question: What was the first major threat he faced there?
questions.answer: A lion came out of the forest to attack him.

questions.question: How far down did he fall before stopping himself?
questions.answer: He stopped about halfway down.

questions.question: What danger threatened that small bit of safety?
questions.answer: Two rats were wearing away the tree’s roots.

questions.question: What did the man see at the top of the well?
questions.answer: He saw the lion waiting there.

questions.question: What surprising sight did the man see near the top of the well?
questions.answer: He saw a fig tree with many different fruits.

questions.question: What was unusual about the tree in the well?
questions.answer: It had many different kinds of fruit on one tree.

questions.question: What was the condition of his heart, spirit, and mind?
questions.answer: They were full of grief and inner pain.

questions.question: What did he do with the fruit, and why was that a bad choice?
questions.answer: He started eating it, and that was bad because some of it was harmful.

questions.question: What poor choice did he make because of this?
questions.answer: He ate fruit carelessly, even though some of it was harmful.

questions.question: What kind of place did the man reach before the danger began?
questions.answer: He reached a deserted wilderness.

questions.question: What made him rush away in fear?
questions.answer: A lion appeared and was about to attack him.

questions.question: How was the tree inside the well connected to the well itself?
questions.answer: It was growing out of the wall of the well.

questions.question: What were the white and black rats doing?
questions.answer: They were gnawing the roots of the tree.

questions.question: What important truth did the man fail to notice about these strange events?
questions.answer: He failed to see that they were not random and that a powerful being was in control.

questions.question: What danger was spread around the inside walls?
questions.answer: Harmful stinging creatures were gathered there.

questions.question: What mistake did he make with the fruit?
questions.answer: He treated the place like a garden and ate from the tree carelessly.

questions.question: What was happening inside him even though he acted differently on the outside?
questions.answer: Deep inside, his heart, spirit, and mind were crying out in pain.

questions.question: Why was that fruit not safe to eat freely?
questions.answer: Some of it was poisonous and harmful.

questions.question: What was the result of the man’s wrong way of thinking?
questions.answer: He stayed in misery, neither escaping it nor finding peace.

questions.question: What happened first that put the man in danger?
questions.answer: He heard a frightening noise and saw a lion coming after him.

questions.question: Which animal caused the man’s first shock and fear?
questions.answer: A lion did.

questions.question: What problem was happening to the roots of the tree?
questions.answer: Two rats were biting through them.

questions.question: What detail shows that his support would not last forever?
questions.answer: Two rats were chewing through the tree’s roots.
